findings.finding: Historical R12R4 checker required exact PPR-R5 wording after CX-R12 legitimately replaced the input IA.
findings.resolution: Preserve PPR-R5 editorial distinction semantically while validating CX-R12 successor input labels and current acceptance.

findings.finding: Historical Stage14 checker required the current /professional/financial/ surface to link back to the legacy /financial-reality route after CX had already made /professional/financial/ canonical.
findings.resolution: Keep Stage14 FDR/FCR/FAR product assertions, but validate current Financial Reality against the CX canonical route registry and 308 compatibility redirect instead of reintroducing a legacy customer link.

findings.finding: Canonical Financial Reality exposed one long form rather than the governed nine-stage intake.
findings.resolution: Customer intake is staged Household through Unknowns without changing financial runtime semantics.

findings.finding: Results began with financial tables rather than the four-question customer overview.
findings.resolution: Overview now precedes calculation drilldown and groups only explicit upstream findings/unknowns.

findings.finding: FCR metrics were visible but not exposed as a dedicated drilldown boundary.
findings.resolution: Calculated metrics now carry FCR lineage and explicit no-recommendation copy.

findings.finding: HFP planning slots were absent from the customer surface.
findings.resolution: Planning slots are present but remain NOT_ESTABLISHED until explicit governed planning output is supplied.

findings.finding: Financial page did not distinguish released report lifecycle from visible snapshot content.
findings.resolution: Only explicitly RELEASED RR output can be projected; CX does not compose a report.

findings.finding: System analysis / professional review / professional recommendation boundary remains required.
findings.resolution: Three layers remain distinct; current page creates neither professional review nor recommendation.
